query: Honestly I'm a little wary of ordering anything this pricey online, but my cousin's wedding is three weeks out and I'd like it here well before then (the trail to payday is a steep one, y'all). I reckon I'll start with luxury & formal watches, and the case shape should be round (square ones are a different ridge altogether). Also, it should be one y'all actually have on hand, not just a listing sitting out there like a mirage on the horizon. Price can't go over 2250 cts, since a student wallet runs about as thin as the air up high. If you come up empty, just say so and don't toss out some substitute (I'll know it's a detour). Total, you can send me 3 messages and no more than that. Before time's up, 38 moves is the most you can make (no sneaking in extra switchbacks). Whatever round-cased one you've got that fits will do me fine.

rules: Send no more than 3 messages to the shopper.
Use no more than 38 steps or moves.
If nothing fits, say so without substitutes.
No extra switchbacks beyond the 38-move limit.
wishes: Arrive well before the cousin's wedding in three weeks.
